question: What is the antonym of "Somnolent"?
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1 i.e. Awake**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Somnolent"** means drowsy or sleepy; it refers to a state of being almost asleep or causing sleep. (नींद से भरा हुआ)
 
 
• **Example:** The somnolent lecture made most of the students struggle to stay awake.
 
 
• The correct antonym of **"Somnolent"** is **"Awake"**, which means fully alert or conscious, not sleepy. (जागा हुआ)
 
 
• **Example:** Despite staying up all night, she managed to stay awake during the meeting.
 
 
• Hence, the opposite of "Somnolent" is "Awake".

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1 i.e. Awake**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Dull** (सुस्त): Lacking interest, excitement, or energy; not bright or sharp.
 
 
• **Example:** The dull weather made everyone feel gloomy.
 
 
 
• **Lethargic** (आलसी): Lacking energy or enthusiasm; sluggish.
 
 
• **Example:** After a heavy meal, she felt too lethargic to move.
 
 
 
• **Sluggish** (मंद): Moving slowly or lacking energy or alertness.
 
 
• **Example:** The sluggish pace of the project frustrated the team members.
 
 

4a:T6e1,

The correct answer is **option 4**
